level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## 2026.10.10-beta.2

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Workspace safety: reject a multi-file `apply_patch` before changing files when a later update target is missing or its context does not match, preserving the original workspace for the next attempt. Commit-time I/O failures can still leave partial effects. (#160409; related #117742 and #127496) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @yetval.
- Tool policy: run plugin `before_tool_call` hooks in standalone `openclaw agent exec` sessions so plugin tool guards take effect. (#159333; fixes #158824) Thanks @joseairosa and @obviyus.
- Buzz: reconnect when a relay closes during NIP-42 authentication without terminating the Gateway or interrupting other channels and sessions. (#170591; fixes #147269) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jarvis-modern-mail, and @RomneyDa.
- macOS downloads: save dashboard and conversation attachments through the native Save dialog while keeping the current page open. (#173654) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- OpenRouter onboarding: accept valid API keys with the default `openrouter/auto` model instead of rejecting setup with a route mismatch. (#173292; related #162798) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @obviyus.
- macOS setup: let fresh native profiles start the Gateway and complete automatic setup, including when supervised startup needs a retry. (#173246)
- Gateway startup: follow a replacement model-runtime refresh instead of exiting when initial preparation is superseded. (#173366; related #173357) Thanks @Jackten and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway logging: keep serving and shut down normally when a deleted temporary-directory backing path makes daily log rollover fail. (#160433; fixes #130807) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @WadeOwenWatts, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- Gateway stability: stop session diff capture from opening live SQLite and hard-linked files, preventing SIGBUS crash loops when the shared-memory file is truncated. (#174017)
- Native app updates: let Doctor finish agent database upgrades on native-first profiles instead of reporting success while the Gateway refuses to start on an older schema. (#174297)
- Cron: plan history maintenance from run identities and load full payloads only for rows it updates, so large cron histories no longer exhaust the SQLite worker's memory and take channels down. (#174530; fixes #174078) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @asikorskiy.

level1_releases.name: v2.1.304
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
- Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
- Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only
- Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
- Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything
- Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)
- Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
- Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config`
- Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a `[user-id]` route folder
- Fixed `rm -r` of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (`/Volumes`, `/media`, WSL's `/mnt/c`) not getting the safety prompt that `rm -rf /Applications` gets
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed
- Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one
- Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded
- Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged
- Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans
